field.label: WAN interface
field.help: Creates default pipes, queues and rules to shape LAN to WAN traffic. Will automatically detect and update existing pipes assigned to WAN interface

field.label: WAN type
field.help: Line type of the WAN. On DSL the upload pipe keeps room for the line overhead of the ACKs of downloads (large on ADSL), and the CoDel target counts the DSL framing. The MTU is read from the WAN interface

field.label: Download threshold (%)
field.help: Recommended to set the download pipe to 90% of the speedtest result

field.label: Upload threshold (%)
field.help: Recommended to set the upload pipe to 90% of the speedtest result

field.label: Days of results
field.help: Days of speedtest results to use. The results of each region (a provider's server in one location) in an hour are averaged, then the regions of the hour, then the hours of each day, then the days; only the hours with as many regions as the scheduled speedtests run (Multiple) count, all hours when there are none. The thresholds apply to that average. A pipe is lowered from the results of these days and raised from twice as many days, but never above the lowering figure, so a line that resyncs lower is followed within a day and recovers slowly

field.label: Minimum change (%)
field.help: A pipe is lowered at once when its figure is at least this percentage below it. It is raised when its figure is at least a quarter of this above it, by at most half of this per update from the second day after it was lowered and by at most this from the fourth day (nothing the day after)
